title: Radio: Distribution Office — ransom note on every desktop

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution Office on DWS-1. Our work-order screen and the AMI tablets won’t load, every file on the S: drive is renamed with a .rptd extension, and there’s a RESTORE-MILLBROOK.txt on every desktop.
Customer Service at City Hall says the billing screens show the same thing. Do you see anything on the plant side?

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged man, steady but uneasy, office noise behind

instructorNote: The first sign is on the business side. Watch whether the IC moves coordination to phone and radio and whether anyone checks the plant against field instruments.

snapshot.title: Radio: DWS-1 — RTU-03 Telemetry Loss & Pressure Drop

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is DWS-1. RTU-03 (Hilltop Transmission Main) shows 'No Connection' on the HMI. The pressure trend in Zone 3 has dropped to 18 psi—below the 20 psi threshold. I'm seeing a flat line on the trend and no updates. I can't verify it from the field yet, but the feed has been dead for 3 minutes.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject triggers the core narrative: a cyber-induced telemetry loss with a pressure drop below threshold. Watch for the IC to order field verification before acting on the advisory. The IT team must begin root-cause analysis immediately.
